SELECT d.id, d.title, d.cover_url, d.status, d.review_state, d.review_note, d.free_episode_count, d.submitted_at, d.reviewed_at, s.id AS supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, s.contact_email AS supplier_contact_email, COALESCE(ep.episode_count, 0) AS episode_count FROM dramas d LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = d.supplier_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT drama_id, COUNT(*) AS episode_count FROM episodes GROUP BY drama_id ) ep ON ep.drama_id = d.id
ORDER BY (d.submitted_at IS NULL) ASC, d.submitted_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
